recentItems.title: Mamdani, NYC officials give update on ICE shooting
recentItems.description:
An Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent shot and hospitalized a man in New York City on Thursday. New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani and NYPD Commissioner Jessica Tisch gave an update on the situation, saying the victim's 5-year-old son was in the car during the incident.
